MATCH (n)
DETACH DELETE n;

MATCH (n)
RETURN count(n);

MATCH ()-[r]->()
RETURN count(r);

MATCH (n)-[r]-()
RETURN n.name, count(r) AS degree
ORDER BY degree DESC
LIMIT 20;

MATCH (n:Layer)
DETACH DELETE n;

MATCH (n:Node)
WHERE n.type = "Component"

MATCH (l:Layer {name:"Component Layer"})

MERGE (n)-[:BELONGS_TO]->(l);

MATCH (n:Node)
WHERE n.type = "Parameter"

MATCH (l:Layer {name:"Parameter Layer"})

MERGE (n)-[:BELONGS_TO]->(l);

MATCH (n:Node)
WHERE n.type = "Equation"

MATCH (l:Layer {name:"Equation Layer"})

MERGE (n)-[:BELONGS_TO]->(l);

MATCH (n:Node)
WHERE n.type = "BoundaryCondition"

MATCH (l:Layer {name:"BoundaryCondition Layer"})

MERGE (n)-[:BELONGS_TO]->(l);

MATCH (c:Layer {name:"Component Layer"})
MATCH (p:Layer {name:"Parameter Layer"})
MATCH (e:Layer {name:"Equation Layer"})
MATCH (b:Layer {name:"BoundaryCondition Layer"})

MERGE (c)-[:DRIVES]->(p)
MERGE (p)-[:USED_IN]->(e)
MERGE (e)-[:LIMITED_BY]->(b);

MATCH (a:Node),(b:Node)

WHERE a.type = "Component"
AND b.type = "Parameter"

AND (
    toLower(a.name) CONTAINS "compress"
    OR toLower(a.name) CONTAINS "turbine"
    OR toLower(a.name) CONTAINS "combust"
)

MERGE (a)-[:AFFECTS]->(b);

MATCH (a:Node),(b:Node)

WHERE a.type = "Parameter"
AND b.type = "Equation"

MERGE (a)-[:USED_IN]->(b);

MATCH (a:Node),(b:Node)

WHERE a.type = "Equation"
AND b.type = "BoundaryCondition"

MERGE (a)-[:LIMITED_BY]->(b);

MATCH ()-[r:AFFECTS]->()
DELETE r;

MATCH ()-[r:USED_IN]->()
DELETE r;

MATCH ()-[r:LIMITED_BY]->()
DELETE r;

MATCH (a:Node),(b:Node)

WHERE a.type = "Component"
AND b.type = "Parameter"

AND toLower(a.name) CONTAINS "compress"
AND toLower(b.name) CONTAINS "pressure"

MERGE (a)-[:AFFECTS]->(b);

MATCH (a:Node),(b:Node)

WHERE a.type = "Component"
AND b.type = "Parameter"

AND toLower(a.name) CONTAINS "turbine"
AND toLower(b.name) CONTAINS "efficiency"

MERGE (a)-[:AFFECTS]->(b);

MATCH (a:Node),(b:Node)

WHERE a.type = "Component"
AND b.type = "Parameter"

AND (
    toLower(a.name) CONTAINS "combust"
    OR toLower(a.name) CONTAINS "burn"
)

AND toLower(b.name) CONTAINS "temperature"

MERGE (a)-[:AFFECTS]->(b);

MATCH (a:Node),(b:Node)

WHERE a.type = "Parameter"
AND b.type = "Equation"

AND toLower(a.name) CONTAINS "pressure"
AND toLower(b.name) CONTAINS "brayton"

MERGE (a)-[:USED_IN]->(b);

MATCH (a:Node),(b:Node)

WHERE a.type = "Parameter"
AND b.type = "Equation"

AND toLower(a.name) CONTAINS "efficiency"
AND toLower(b.name) CONTAINS "efficiency"

MERGE (a)-[:USED_IN]->(b);

MATCH (a:Node),(b:Node)

WHERE a.type = "Equation"
AND b.type = "BoundaryCondition"

AND toLower(a.name) CONTAINS "temperature"

MERGE (a)-[:LIMITED_BY]->(b);

MATCH (n)-[r]->(m)
RETURN n,r,m

MATCH (n)-[r*1..2]-(m)
WHERE n.name CONTAINS "compress"
RETURN n,r,m
LIMIT 80;
